units.function: Pure policy tests deciding whether a provider task session should reset for timer, assignment, review, approval, change-request, comment and retry wake reasons, plus an English diagnostic reason.
units.dependencyDirection: Pure Heartbeat helper over an untyped wake-context object; no persistence or adapter invocation.
units.keyDataModels: Wake reason, optional Issue scope and forceFreshSession flag.
units.lifecycle: Start fresh for exploratory unscoped timers and new review/approval work, preserve context for Issue-scoped timers/comments/retries, and keep the boolean decision consistent with a diagnostic string.
units.testAssessment: Fourteen concise cases cover known, unknown, null, forced and scoped inputs and cross-check the explanation against the decision. Missing are a versioned exhaustive wake enum, adapter capability differences, session privacy/retention limits, failed reset behavior and stable diagnostic codes.
units.designRationale: Balance context quality/cost: exploratory activity should not grow stale context indefinitely, while continuation work should not repay orientation cost.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs reproducible Connector session policy without treating any vendor's private session as the Work or responsibility record.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE the fresh-versus-continuation policy distinction. Put session reuse/reset behind Connector capability and retention policy; core should bind attempts to Work/evidence contracts using opaque external session references, stable reason codes and no private reasoning.
units.responsibilityConflict: Wake reason alone does not prove whether prior context is still authorized for the current human, data scope or approval contract, and English explanations are not protocol fields.

units.function: A unit test for emitting a workspace-ready Issue comment with duplicate Markdown body plus structured presentation metadata.
units.dependencyDirection: Heartbeat presentation helper calls IssueService.addComment using a realized workspace and runtime-service list.
units.keyDataModels: RealizedExecutionWorkspace strategy/branch/CWD and version-1 system-notice presentation metadata.
units.lifecycle: After workspace realization, publish an Agent/Run-authored informational comment containing strategy, branch and absolute CWD in both Markdown and structured rows.
units.testAssessment: One exact interaction test catches argument-order/presentation regressions but is brittle to English copy and tests no warnings, runtime services, remote/sandbox workspace, missing branch, path redaction or authorization.
units.designRationale: Expose execution-environment readiness in the Work thread and allow the UI to render it as a compact structured notice.
units.companyOsProblem: Agent Boss needs a safe, structured execution-environment receipt rather than raw infrastructure prose.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE the structured notice projection, not the comment body. Company OS should persist a versioned EnvironmentReady receipt with Connector/workspace opaque IDs, capability and attestation digest; Web localizes it and only shows sanitized labels permitted by deployment profile.
units.responsibilityConflict: Publishing absolute filesystem paths and branch names can leak local enterprise topology, while the notice omits responsible human, data/approval contract and environment attestation.
evidence: a388ea1cac073f41b0ce00ee3293f17199dd9e09 Render workspace-ready comments as compact system notices (#10636)

units.function: Pure tests that refuse to coalesce new wakes into a database Run marked running when its ID is absent from the current process's runningProcesses map.
units.dependencyDirection: Pure predicate/filter over a Run-like object and in-memory process registry.
units.keyDataModels: Run ID/status and local running-process membership.
units.lifecycle: Treat only untracked running Runs as zombies; filter them from coalescing so a new queued Run can be created instead of refreshing the dead Run timestamp.
units.testAssessment: Thirteen readable unit cases cover running/queued/terminal/null, post-restart and mixed live/zombie cases. They do not cover another server instance owning the Run, detached/remote Connector execution, stale process entries, liveness attestation, race between check and coalesce or actual database behavior.
units.designRationale: Avoid making a dead Run immortal by repeatedly coalescing work into it and refreshing its age.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS must never coalesce work into an execution attempt whose lease or Connector attestation is no longer live.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE the no-coalescing-into-dead-attempt invariant, but reject local process-map membership as production liveness. Use durable lease owner/epoch, expiry, Connector heartbeat/attestation and an atomic conditional coalesce.
units.responsibilityConflict: Absence from one process map is not proof of death in managed multi-node or self-hosted execution, and creating a replacement without fencing the prior authority can duplicate an approved high-risk action.
